name: Color Position
tagline: Move a red object to sweep the stereo field.
description: A red hue mask isolates an object. Its largest region X position controls a pan parameter; unlike Color Focus, it follows position rather than the amount of red. No identity tracking is performed.
steps: Place a single saturated red object in front of a contrasting background.
Map CC 10, channel 1 to pan in your instrument or DAW.
Move the object left to right while keeping it visible.
If the object disappears, X becomes zero; competing red objects can switch the largest region.
